paragraphs: CLEAR sells an annual membership that verifies a traveler's identity and moves them through dedicated airport security lanes. The company describes itself more broadly as an identity business rather than an airport one.

Members can add up to three other people to an account, and CLEAR also handles enrollment and renewal for TSA PreCheck. An app is meant to cover the rest of the travel day, telling a member when to leave home to reach the gate on time. The same verification is offered away from airports, including entry at sports stadiums and arenas by showing a QR code in the app. A business-facing line called CLEAR1 extends the identity checks to enterprises.

Caryn Seidman Becker is the Chair, CEO and Founder. The company says she acquired CLEAR out of bankruptcy in 2010 and grew it to 62 airport locations, hundreds of partners and more than 43 million verified users nationwide.

quote.text: An identity company that powers effortless experiences wherever you go.
